prerequisites.reason: Activation functions are essential for determining the output in feedforward networks.
Loss functions are used to evaluate the performance of feedforward networks.
Backpropagation is used to train feedforward networks.
Gradient descent is the optimization method used in backpropagation.
Understanding feedforward networks is necessary to grasp various neural network models.
Computational graphs are used to visualize and implement backpropagation.
Understanding loss functions is crucial for evaluating model generalization.
Linear separability is a fundamental concept that affects the design of feedforward networks.
